setup_sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pgaccel_corpus.manifests WHERE dataset_id = 'nyc-yellow-2015-01-aviz-raw-v1' AND source_sha256 = '435108d38567a54e3a58ffd5b21b641db57fcd1be05fe3b8b84fb3b66f3d94bf' AND source_rows = 12748986) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pinned NYC corpus missing or mismatched; run scripts/nyc_taxi_corpus.py import'; END IF; END $$
CREATE TABLE bench_nyc_taxi AS SELECT id, vendor_id, passenger_count, fare_amount, trip_distance FROM pgaccel_corpus.nyc_yellow_2015_01 WHERE id <= 1000000 ORDER BY id
DO $$ BEGIN IF (SELECT count(*) FROM bench_nyc_taxi) <> 1000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NYC corpus prefix is incomplete'; END IF; END $$
accel_query_sql: SELECT vendor_id, count(*) AS n, sum(passenger_count) AS passengers, avg(passenger_count) AS mean_passengers, sum(fare_amount) AS fares, avg(trip_distance) AS mean_distance FROM bench_nyc_taxi GROUP BY 1
